name: fix-firearms-snipe
about: The Marksman's Sniper Shot (2026-10-22, the user's items): the channel is a rank value, 650 ms at rank 1 down to 325 at rank 5, armor penetration 30/35/45/50/60 % (sniper_snipe.sval upgrade dicts), and the Recoil Roll orb (hwp_fs_snipe_recoil, Marksman.as HWPFirearmsSnipeRecoil) throws the shooter back a dash with 400 ms of evade. Through the fix_firearms_snipe bot: `hwp firearms snipe` at every rank, a real Snipe at ranks 1 and 5, then the orb on, off, and the shooter's displacement, the buff in gl state and the log line.
